title: PWLR: Pairwise Witness Local Rejection for Boundary-Aware Out-of-Distribution Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.15802v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection remains challenging for image classifiers, especially when near-OOD samples lie close to in-distribution (ID) class boundaries. Recent vision-language detectors improve OOD detection through class semantics, local prompting, or LLM-generated outlier concepts, but seldom use language as explicit boundary evidence between confusing ID classes. We propose Pairwise Witness Local Rejection (PWLR), which uses an MLLM offline to describe visible local cues that favor one ID class over a specific rival class. These cue phrases are then screened with ID-only data under a frozen vision-language backbone, so that only reliable local verifiers are kept. At inference, PWLR first retains a small set of globally plausible classes, then checks whether any of them is locally supported against its most relevant rivals, and finally combines this pairwise local evidence with the global class score through calibration. translated_title: PWLR：用于边界感知的分布外检测的成对见证局部拒绝方法
translated_abstract: 分布外（OOD）检测对图像分类器而言仍具挑战性，尤其是当近OOD样本接近分布内（ID）类边界时。最近的视觉-语言检测器通过类别语义、局部提示或LLM生成的异常概念来改进OOD检测，但很少使用语言作为混淆ID类之间的显式边界证据。我们提出了成对见证局部拒绝（PWLR），它利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）离线描述有利于某个ID类相对于特定竞争类的可见局部线索。这些线索短语随后在冻结的视觉-语言骨干下仅用ID数据进行筛选，从而仅保留可靠的局部验证器。在推理时，PWLR首先保留一小部分全局可能的类别，然后检查其中是否有任何类别在其最相关的竞争对手上得到局部支持，最后通过校准将这种成对局部证据与全局类别分数结合。
tldr: 本论文提出了一种名为PWLR的新方法，通过多模态大语言模型生成成对局部线索，并结合全局分数，显著提升了边界附近分布外样本的检测精度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PWLR, a novel method that leverages pairwise local cues from an MLLM combined with global scores to significantly improve out-of-distribution detection near class boundaries.
